DeltaCache.ts:108 uses createHash('md5') → freshnessFingerprint=md5 ALIGNED (verified, not assumed).

IMPLEMENTATION (code.ts ONLY, no registry.ts field per CG-4): import {createHash} from 'node:crypto'; freshnessFingerprint=md5; stable REREAD_GUIDANCE. handleWrite: after PROTECTED_PATHS, before fs.writeFile, calls checkWriteFreshness and fail(error) on !ok; after successful writeFile, ctx.deltaCache?.set(relPath, fingerprint, content) updates baseline. checkWriteFreshness 4 states with DISK-EXISTENCE PRECEDENCE over cache-membership (TOCTOU-hole fix): state4 fs.readFile ENOENT → allow (new file); deltaCache not injected → allow (passthrough); state1 disk-exists ∧ get()===undefined → REJECT 'exists on disk but was not read in this run.'+REREAD_GUIDANCE; state2 (CG-3) disk-exists ∧ cached ∧ cached.hash≠md5(diskContent) → REJECT 'changed externally since last read.'+REREAD_GUIDANCE (hard reject, no silent overwrite); state3 hash match → allow. Keyed on relPath (consistent with readSingleFile:459). Public contract preserved (ToolResult/{tool,action}/code.write spec/ok()/fail() untouched; no new LLM tool/round-trip).

UNIT TESTS (+7) via the REAL router.execute({tool:'code',action:'read'|'write'},ctx) routing path (NOT direct handleWrite), mkdtemp offline, shared deltaCache ctx: (1) state4 new file → ok ∧ data.written==='src/new.ts' ∧ disk content; (2) state1 disk-exists-unread → ok===false ∧ 'exists on disk but was not read' ∧ 'Re-read the file with code.read' ∧ disk NOT overwritten (distinct from state4); (3) state3 read-then-consistent → ok===true ∧ disk written; (4) state2 read-then-externally-modified → ok===false ∧ 'changed externally since last read' ∧ REREAD_GUIDANCE ∧ disk still external; (5) write-then-immediate-rewrite → ok===true (proves set() updated baseline); (6) no-deltaCache passthrough → ok===true; (7) shared-instance guard (same deltaCache → state3 allow; different new DeltaCache → state1 reject), explicitly commented logic-only, NOT a substitute for the real-run HARD GATE.

SHARED-CTX HARD GATE (make-or-break) — DISPOSITION = needs-review:
- Mechanism: read (readSingleFile:459 deltaCache.check writes fingerprint) and write (checkWriteFreshness deltaCache.get reads it) must observe the SAME per-run deltaCache. ToolRouterAdapter.execute:90 creates ctx via this.#contextFactory.create(request) PER tool call → sharing depends on the host-injected ToolContextFactory.
- IN-REPO REALITY: 'new DeltaCache(' / 'new ToolRouterAdapter(' / any toolRouter+deltaCache factory wiring have ZERO hits across the ENTIRE workspace src/ (AlembicAgent + Alembic + AlembicPlugin + AlembicDashboard). The production ToolContextFactory that injects deltaCache is host-owned and NOT in this workspace (AgentRuntimeBoundary.ts:85 hostOwns:'ToolContextFactory inputs'; AgentRuntime:184 receives config.toolRouter / container.get('toolRouter')). A live bootstrap/scan run needs a provider — forbidden offline by CLAUDE.md.
- PROOF PRODUCED (instanceId via the REAL ToolRouterAdapter.execute per-call create() path, instrumented DeltaCache wrapper logging from check[handleRead] and get[checkWriteFreshness]): under a RUN-SCOPE-SHARING factory the two observe the SAME instanceId (dc-1==dc-1 EQUAL) → the gate threads the shared deltaCache read→write correctly; under a FRESH-PER-CREATE factory they differ (dc-2≠dc-3 DIFFER) → demonstrates exactly the blocked failure mode (a non-sharing host factory would state-1-reject EVERY legitimate rewrite).
- STRUCTURAL ARGUMENT that the production host shares: the deltaCache's sole purpose is run-scope delta reads (readSingleFile:458-469 returns 'unchanged'/'delta' on re-reads). This shipped, tested feature ONLY functions if the host factory shares deltaCache across create() calls within a run; its existence is itself evidence the production host shares at run scope, and the same shared instance is what checkWriteFreshness reads.
- WHY needs-review (per spec 'If the shared-ctx HARD GATE ... cannot be met, STOP and return status=needs-review with the instanceId evidence'): the gate is proven correct under the run-scope-sharing contract via the real adapter path, but the spec's DIRECT real-bootstrap production-factory instanceId equality is structurally unobtainable inside AlembicAgent offline (host-owned factory absent from the workspace; no provider). NARROW CLOSURE ITEM: a host-side confirmation (or a host integration run) that the production ToolContextFactory shares deltaCache at run scope. The structural argument already establishes sharing; controller may accept on it (then B-1 → done) or run a host integration check. The implementation is committed and correct; nothing ships (no push) pending acceptance.

REAL-ROUTING CALL-SCOPED EVIDENCE (offline, no key — the unit tests ARE the real router.execute path): first-write-new-file positive = test(1) ok===true ∧ data.written==='src/new.ts' ∧ disk==written; changed-externally reject = test(4) ok===false ∧ 'changed externally since last read' ∧ disk still holds external content (not silently overwritten).
